# Observed BigQuery answers recorded with tools/bqanswers. ARRAY_FIRST_N is
# available despite being absent from the saved array function documentation;
# SAFE. is rejected, and the other three GoogleSQL functions do not exist.

SELECT ARRAY_FIRST_N([33, 22, 11], 2)
=> [{"v":"33"},{"v":"22"}]

SELECT SAFE.ARRAY_FIRST_N([33, 22, 11], 2)
=> error contains: SAFE with function array_first_n is not supported.

SELECT ARRAY_FIRST_N([33, 22, 11], 0)
=> []

SELECT ARRAY_FIRST_N([33, 22, 11], 3)
=> [{"v":"33"},{"v":"22"},{"v":"11"}]

SELECT ARRAY_FIRST_N([33, 22, 11], 4)
=> [{"v":"33"},{"v":"22"},{"v":"11"}]

SELECT ARRAY_FIRST_N([33, 22, 11], 9223372036854775807)
=> [{"v":"33"},{"v":"22"},{"v":"11"}]

SELECT ARRAY_FIRST_N([33, 22, 11], -1)
=> error contains: ARRAY_FIRST_N second argument must be non-negative

SELECT SAFE.ARRAY_FIRST_N([33, 22, 11], -1)
=> error contains: SAFE with function array_first_n is not supported.

SELECT ARRAY_FIRST_N(ARRAY<INT64>[], 2)
=> []

SELECT ARRAY_FIRST_N(CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<INT64>), -1) IS NULL
=> "true"

SELECT ARRAY_FIRST_N([33, 22, 11], CAST(NULL AS INT64)) IS NULL
=> "true"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_FIRST_N([NULL, 22, 11], 2))
=> "[null,22]"

SELECT ARRAY_FIRST_N(['a', 'b', 'c'], 2)
=> [{"v":"a"},{"v":"b"}]

SELECT ARRAY_FIRST_N([STRUCT(1 AS x), STRUCT(2 AS x)], 1)
=> [{"v":{"f":[{"v":"1"}]}}]

SELECT ARRAY_LAST_N([33, 22, 11], 2)
=> error contains: Function not found: ARRAY_LAST_N

SELECT SAFE.ARRAY_LAST_N([33, 22, 11], 2)
=> error contains: Function not found: ARRAY_LAST_N

SELECT ARRAY_REMOVE_FIRST_N([33, 22, 11], 2)
=> error contains: Function not found: ARRAY_REMOVE_FIRST_N

SELECT SAFE.ARRAY_REMOVE_FIRST_N([33, 22, 11], 2)
=> error contains: Function not found: ARRAY_REMOVE_FIRST_N

SELECT ARRAY_REMOVE_LAST_N([33, 22, 11], 2)
=> error contains: Function not found: ARRAY_REMOVE_LAST_N

SELECT SAFE.ARRAY_REMOVE_LAST_N([33, 22, 11], 2)
=> error contains: Function not found: ARRAY_REMOVE_LAST_N
